title: Spring Tagine with Algerian Flair
description: A vibrant and flavorful vegan tagine inspired by Algerian cuisine, perfect for a spring evening. This recipe showcases the beauty of plant-based cooking with the use of colorful vegetables and aromatic spices.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large clay or earthenware tagine dish over medium heat.
Add the cumin, coriander, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper. Cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the chopped spring onions, carrots, and red bell pepper to the tagine. Cook for 5-7 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
Stir in the lemon juice and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Add the Algerian couscous to the tagine and stir to combine.
Reduce the heat to low and cover the tagine with a lid.
Simmer the tagine for 20-25 minutes, or until the couscous is cooked and the liquid has been absorbed.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh herbs and lemon wedges if desired.
Adjust the seasoning as needed and enjoy!
